claims.claim: Economy is mandatory for flights under six hours, and those flights have to be reserved through the company's approved booking tool.
Any individual travel expense at or above $75 needs an itemized receipt rather than just the card record.
Travelers receive a daily meal allowance of $85.
A lost or stolen device must be reported within one hour when an employee is outside their home country.
Reaching internal systems while traveling requires both a company-issued device and a second authentication factor.
